question: Does a different cable and charger work?
Replace the cable or charger
text: Cables wear out inside even when they look fine. Use a certified cable and charger.

question: Clean the charging port
text: Turn the phone off and gently remove lint from the port with a wooden toothpick. Then try again.

question: Use a wall charger
text: Laptop USB ports and car chargers are slow. A wall charger of 18 W or more charges much faster.

question: Let the phone cool down
text: Phones pause charging when they are hot. Remove the case, keep it out of the sun and try again in 10 minutes.
